title: Phison E12 and E18 PCIe SSD controllers contain a Secure Boot bypass vulnerability that allows a privileged local…
description: Phison E12 and E18 PCIe SSD controllers have a Secure Boot bypass vulnerability that allows a privileged local attacker to inject persistent boot-patch tuples into an unsigned, CRC-protected flash ID page. This manipulation forces the firmware verification to rely on CRC checks instead of signature validation, enabling loading of unsigned firmware. The vulnerability permits a persistent implant at the controller level that survives firmware reinstallation and operates below the host OS.
